name: Survey tile in Aries
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.6 degrees north of the ecliptic in Aries, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 5 visits over 54 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.2 days starting 2026-01-30, at wavelengths from 0.77 to 4.25 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
